provenance.status: assistant diagnostic, not independently adjudicated ground truth

scope.new_selection: Deterministic pseudo-random ranking within source strata, excluding the 24 previously inspected packets and known customs case; one human version and wording 1 per newly sampled template

screening_only.warning: Keyword screening flags are not validated errors. Broad no-additional phrasing can refer to selected outcomes while other recipient benefits still exist.

new_diagnostic_sample.assessment: Reciprocal QA-certificate exchange and pre-clearance are stated; Qwen correctly identifies exchange/information sharing. Equal outcomes for both and actor opportunity cost are not established relative to sequential customs inspection.
new_diagnostic_sample.field_summary: interaction supported; comparative outcomes and cost not established

new_diagnostic_sample.assessment: Mutual waypoint telemetry provides navigational clearance. Information sharing is supported; equal outcomes and an actor opportunity cost are not established relative to standard radar-only navigation.
new_diagnostic_sample.field_summary: interaction supported; actor/recipient equality and cost unsupported

new_diagnostic_sample.assessment: Consolidated sky-survey registry explicitly adds no overhead or observing-schedule change; Qwen nevertheless assigns opportunity_cost. Information sharing is supported; global payoff equality is not established merely by unchanged schedule.
new_diagnostic_sample.field_summary: explicit no-overhead language conflicts with cost assertion

new_diagnostic_sample.assessment: Lending the loading ramp for thirty minutes provides requested access to the perishable-produce carrier and displaces actor loading time. Qwen correctly identifies unilateral help and an opportunity cost.
new_diagnostic_sample.field_summary: supported help, recipient benefit, and actor opportunity cost

new_diagnostic_sample.assessment: Providing the nearby clinic with a power line uses 10% of generator capacity. Unilateral helping, recipient benefit, and a stated resource draw are supported.
Splitting a wholesale timber invoice is a requested unilateral accommodation, requiring a specified fifteen minutes of administrative work.

Surrendering an urgent medical-device production slot to a graduate student is assistance that sacrifices the actor's assigned slot and conflicts with a mandatory production objective. Lexical favourability is not certified here.
new_diagnostic_sample.field_summary: supported unilateral help and objective conflict

new_diagnostic_sample.assessment: Sharing sealed-bid production costs with a competitor to coordinate tenders conflicts with independent public procurement requirements. Recipient benefit, realized actor cost, and lexical preference are not textually established; compatible_distinct goal structure misses the normative conflict.
new_diagnostic_sample.field_summary: cost and beneficiary inference unsupported; goal structure ambiguous

new_diagnostic_sample.assessment: Painting an actively ruptured water pipe is explicitly ineffective; isolation before repair is materially better. Parallel activity and absence of dependence are plausible. The source stem lacks an explicit second-person actor, a separate role-normalization concern.

The target transmits on a decommissioned, unmonitored maritime radio band; the reference uses certified VHF. Qwen reports both outcomes unclear and neutral wording. Operational reference advantage is strongly suggested, though communication success is not quantified.
new_diagnostic_sample.field_summary: under-recognition of negative-control consequences; ambiguous degree

new_diagnostic_sample.assessment: Cross-facility voltage synchronization is said to stabilize distribution feeders; no reserve draw or revenue change is specified. Qwen correctly says no actor cost is stated, but global actor/recipient equality is not proven from those two matched dimensions.

Dual-stream conveyor operation matches standalone actor time, labor, and refrigeration. Qwen correctly captures actor equality on these dimensions but invents opportunity_cost and asserts recipient equality/coordination benefit without stated evidence.
new_diagnostic_sample.field_summary: unsupported actor cost, recipient equality, and improvement

new_diagnostic_sample.assessment: Ultrasonic frequency interleaving is described without a quantified reference outcome or recipient gain. Qwen records outcomes unclear, actor cost uncertain, and parallel activity. Those cautious labels are defensible.

Combining conveyor operations saves twenty minutes of the actor's labor time. Qwen correctly records actor target_better but also assigns an unsupported opportunity_cost and recipient equal despite no explicit recipient comparison.
new_diagnostic_sample.field_summary: actor improvement correct; cost and recipient equality unsupported

new_diagnostic_sample.assessment: Linking encryption equipment delays the actor from thirty to forty minutes. Qwen correctly assigns actor reference_better, realized time cost, and recipient unclear; beneficial_not_necessary interdependence has no explicitly stated benefit.
new_diagnostic_sample.field_summary: actor outcome correct; coordination benefit unsupported

new_diagnostic_sample.assessment: SCADA alignment supplies the counterpart with vapor-flow rates specifically to prevent condenser icing, while actor moisture/denaturation metrics remain matched. Qwen labels recipient equal and actor opportunity cost; both overclaim what the source establishes.
new_diagnostic_sample.field_summary: missed stated counterpart-useful information; cost unsupported

new_diagnostic_sample.assessment: Shared diesel-injection timing maps provide starboard engineers torque phase angles to eliminate hull vibration harmonics. Qwen labels recipient equal, assumes actor opportunity cost, and may overread joint production from information sharing.

A shared GIS service matches actor export precision/time/cost while providing the partner reference benchmarks. Qwen correctly identifies information sharing, target_better for recipient, equal actor on stated measures, and no stated actor cost.
new_diagnostic_sample.field_summary: beneficiary attribution and matched actor measures supported
